Session at World AI Summit 2026

Suman Guha is a confirmed speaker at World AI Summit 2026, 14-15 October 2026, Sheraton Grand Bangalore Hotel at Brigade Gateway, Bengaluru, India. Session title, time and hall will be published on this page once the agenda is final. See the agenda.

About Suman Guha

Suman Guha is Chief Digital & Technology Officer at Croma, the Tata group's consumer electronics retail chain run by Infiniti Retail, a Tata Digital company. Guha joined Croma in August 2024 and heads its product management, technology, engineering, UX, data, information security, infrastructure and IT functions, leading AI adoption across functions, migration from SAP ECC to S/4HANA and modernisation of the commerce platforms. Until March 2026 Guha also held a dual role as CTO of Tata CLiQ and head of technology for Tata Digital's commerce entities.

Before Tata, Guha was Chief Product and Technology Officer for Reliance Retail's fashion, sports and Tira beauty businesses (2021-24). Earlier roles include Head of Business Critical Services product and engineering at Cisco, product leader for price, promotions and loyalty at Tesco in the UK, leader of Teradata's IntelliCloud service and Principal at Red Hat in the US.

Guha has completed executive programmes at Stanford Graduate School of Business and The Wharton School, and a MicroMasters in data science from UC San Diego.

About Tata Croma (Tata Digital)

Croma is the Tata group's consumer electronics and durables retail chain, founded in 2006 and operated by Infiniti Retail Limited, a subsidiary of Tata Digital. Headquartered in Mumbai, it runs more than 500 stores across over 170 cities alongside croma.com and the Tata Neu app, and reported revenue of Rs 19,064 crore for FY2025.
